ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a 1.5 A current source, with the arrow upward, connected between the upper and lower common buses. In parallel with it there is a vertical 10 Ω resistor branch that is always connected. In the middle there is also a vertical branch controlled by switch S; after the switch is closed, this branch contains a 10 Ω resistor, and the current i(t) is labeled as flowing downward through this branch. The right-side branch goes from the upper bus first through a 10 Ω resistor, then in series with a 15 mH inductor back to the bottom bus. The problem statement says S has been open for a long time and is closed at t=0. Reasoning: When t<0 and the switch has been open for a long time, the middle 10 Ω branch does not exist; in DC steady state the inductor is equivalent to a short circuit, so the two available branches are respectively the left-side 10 Ω resistor and the right-side 10 Ω resistor plus the short-circuit inductor, that is, two equivalent 10 Ω branches in parallel. The 1.5 A current source current is distributed equally, therefore the current in the right-side inductor branch is i_L(0^-)=0.75 A. The inductor current is continuous, so i_L(0^+)=0.75 A. In the final DC steady state after the switch is closed, the inductor is still equivalent to a short circuit, and the circuit becomes three equivalent 10 Ω branches in parallel, therefore each branch gets 1.5/3=0.5 A, so i_L(∞)=0.5 A. Finding the time constant: Looking outward from the inductor port, turning off the independent current source means opening the current source. The upper terminal of the inductor is connected to the upper node through the right-side top 10 Ω resistor, and from that upper node to the lower node there are two 10 Ω resistors in parallel, therefore R_th=10+(10||10)=10+5=15 Ω. The inductor L=15 mH, so τ=L/R_th=0.015/15=0.001 s. Thus the inductor branch current is i_L(t)=i_L(∞)+[i_L(0^+)-i_L(∞)]e^{-t/τ}=0.5+0.25e^{-1000t} A. Let the upper node voltage after the switch is closed be v(t), then the current through the left-side vertical 10 Ω resistor is v/10, the current being sought in the middle is i(t)=v/10, and the current in the right-side inductor branch is i_L(t). By KCL: v/10+v/10+i_L(t)=1.5, therefore v/10=(1.5-i_L(t))/2. Substituting i_L(t)=0.5+0.25e^{-1000t}, obtain i(t)=0.5-0.125e^{-1000t} A.

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit from the image: identify the 1.5 A source, the always-connected 10 Ω shunt, the switched 10 Ω branch carrying i(t), and the right 10 Ω–15 mH series inductor branch. From the text, note that S is open for a long time, so before switching the middle branch is absent and the inductor is a short in DC steady state; the two available 10 Ω paths share the 1.5 A equally, so the inductor branch current at 0−, hence 0+, is 0.75 A. After S closes, the final DC circuit has three equal 10 Ω branches in parallel, so the final inductor-branch current is 0.5 A. Compute the time constant by looking into the inductor terminals with the source killed: 10 Ω in series with 10 Ω || 10 Ω = 15 Ω, so tau=0.001 s. Thus the inductor current is 0.5+0.25e^{-1000t}. Finally apply KCL at the top node after switching, where the two vertical 10 Ω resistor currents plus the inductor-branch current sum to 1.5 A, and take the switched branch current as v/10 to get i(t)=0.5-0.125e^{-1000t} A.

图像描述：图中左侧是一个 1.5 A 电流源，箭头向上，连接在上下两条公共母线之间。与它并联有一个始终接入的竖直 10 Ω 电阻支路。中间还有一条由开关 S 控制的竖直支路，开关闭合后该支路包含一个 10 Ω 电阻，电流 i(t) 标注为向下流过该支路。右侧支路从上母线先经过一个 10 Ω 电阻，再串联一个 15 mH 电感回到底部母线。题意说明 S 长时间断开，并在 t=0 时闭合。

推理：在 t<0 且开关长时间断开时，中间 10 Ω 支路不存在；直流稳态下电感等效为短路，所以可用的两条支路分别是左侧 10 Ω 电阻和右侧的 10 Ω 电阻加短路电感，即两条等效 10 Ω 支路并联。1.5 A 电流源电流平均分配，因此右侧电感支路电流 i_L(0^-)=0.75 A。电感电流连续，所以 i_L(0^+)=0.75 A。

开关闭合后的最终直流稳态中，电感仍等效为短路，电路变为三条等效 10 Ω 支路并联，因此每条支路分得 1.5/3=0.5 A，所以 i_L(∞)=0.5 A。

求时间常数：从电感端口向外看，关闭独立电流源即开路电流源。电感上端通过右侧顶部 10 Ω 电阻接到上节点，而该上节点到下节点有两个 10 Ω 电阻并联，因此 R_th=10+(10||10)=10+5=15 Ω。电感 L=15 mH，所以 τ=L/R_th=0.015/15=0.001 s。于是电感支路电流为 i_L(t)=i_L(∞)+[i_L(0^+)-i_L(∞)]e^{-t/τ}=0.5+0.25e^{-1000t} A。

令开关闭合后的上节点电压为 v(t)，则左侧竖直 10 Ω 电阻电流为 v/10，中间被求的电流 i(t)=v/10，右侧电感支路电流为 i_L(t)。由 KCL：v/10+v/10+i_L(t)=1.5，因此 v/10=(1.5-i_L(t))/2。代入 i_L(t)=0.5+0.25e^{-1000t}，得到 i(t)=0.5-0.125e^{-1000t} A。

推理：开关闭合后，顶部节点向下有三条通路：左侧 10 Ω 电阻、中间闭合开关后的 10 Ω 电阻，以及右侧由 10 Ω 电阻串联 15 mH 电感组成的支路。设顶部节点电压为 v(t)，右侧支路电流为 j(t)，方向从上到下。由于开关在 t=0 前已打开很久，电感在直流稳态下等效为短路，中间支路断开，因此 1.5 A 电流在左侧 10 Ω 电阻和右侧 10 Ω 电阻两条相等支路中平均分配，所以 j(0^-)=0.75 A。电感电流连续，因此 j(0^+)=0.75 A。

对 t≥0^+，由顶部节点 KCL：v/10 + v/10 + j = 1.5。右侧串联支路电压关系为：v = 10j + 0.015 dj/dt。由 KCL 得 v = 5(1.5-j)=7.5-5j。代入右支路方程：7.5-5j = 10j + 0.015 dj/dt，即 0.015 dj/dt + 15j = 7.5。稳态值 j(∞)=7.5/15=0.5 A，时间常数对应指数因子 e^{-1000t}，所以 j(t)=0.5+(0.75-0.5)e^{-1000t}=0.5+0.25e^{-1000t}。

中间支路电流 i(t)=v/10。由 KCL 可写 i(t)=0.75-0.5j(t)，代入 j(t) 得 i(t)=0.75-0.5(0.5+0.25e^{-1000t})=0.5-0.125e^{-1000t} A。

中间支路电流 i(t)=v/10。由 KCL 可写 i(t)=0.75-0.5j(t)，代入 j(t) 得 i(t)=0.75-0.5(0.5+0.25e^{-1000t})=0.5-0.125e^{-1000t} A。

raw_record.original_question: In the circuit shown, the switch \( S \) is open for a long time and is closed at \( t = 0 \). What is the expression for the current \( i(t) \) for \( t \geq 0^+ \)?
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: On the left side of the figure is a 1.5 A current source, with the arrow upward, connected between the upper and lower common buses. In parallel with it there is a vertical 10 Ω resistor branch that is always connected. In the middle there is also a vertical branch controlled by switch S; after the switch is closed, this branch contains a 10 Ω resistor, and the current i(t) is labeled as flowing downward through this branch. The right-side branch goes from the upper bus first through a 10 Ω resistor, then in series with a 15 mH inductor back to the bottom bus. The problem statement says S has been open for a long time and is closed at t=0.

Reasoning: When t<0 and the switch has been open for a long time, the middle 10 Ω branch does not exist; in DC steady state the inductor is equivalent to a short circuit, so the two available branches are respectively the left-side 10 Ω resistor and the right-side 10 Ω resistor plus the short-circuit inductor, that is, two equivalent 10 Ω branches in parallel. The 1.5 A current source current is distributed equally, therefore the current in the right-side inductor branch is i_L(0^-)=0.75 A. The inductor current is continuous, so i_L(0^+)=0.75 A.

In the final DC steady state after the switch is closed, the inductor is still equivalent to a short circuit, and the circuit becomes three equivalent 10 Ω branches in parallel, therefore each branch gets 1.5/3=0.5 A, so i_L(∞)=0.5 A.

Finding the time constant: Looking outward from the inductor port, turning off the independent current source means opening the current source. The upper terminal of the inductor is connected to the upper node through the right-side top 10 Ω resistor, and from that upper node to the lower node there are two 10 Ω resistors in parallel, therefore R_th=10+(10||10)=10+5=15 Ω. The inductor L=15 mH, so τ=L/R_th=0.015/15=0.001 s. Thus the inductor branch current is i_L(t)=i_L(∞)+[i_L(0^+)-i_L(∞)]e^{-t/τ}=0.5+0.25e^{-1000t} A.

Let the upper node voltage after the switch is closed be v(t), then the current through the left-side vertical 10 Ω resistor is v/10, the current being sought in the middle is i(t)=v/10, and the current in the right-side inductor branch is i_L(t). By KCL: v/10+v/10+i_L(t)=1.5, therefore v/10=(1.5-i_L(t))/2. Substituting i_L(t)=0.5+0.25e^{-1000t}, obtain i(t)=0.5-0.125e^{-1000t} A.
